name: comp-404
title: Avatar Group 36px
description: Renders a group of four circular avatars at 36px size with negative margins to create an overlap effect. Each avatar has a ring-2 border using theme background color.
use_when: Larger avatar groups for hero sections or when avatars need prominent display without taking horizontal space.
avoid_when: More than four avatars or when you need individual avatar state — this is a static group layout.
a11y: Each image has alt text. No interactive elements or motion; passive layout.
